args.subject: Corrected quotation needed - 4 Thistlewick Rise, Larkcombe, ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body:
Hi Ewan, regarding the shower/bathroom works at 4 Thistlewick Rise, Larkcombe, ZZ1 1ZZ. Before the landlord can decide, please send one reissued, itemised quotation that settles the following:
1. Your quotation NBL-001-Q1 (18 Sept) shows a different property address from the one above. Please reissue it for 4 Thistlewick Rise, Larkcombe, ZZ1 1ZZ.
2. It shows a subtotal of £2,370.00 + VAT £474.00 = £2,844.00. Your breakdown (materials £1,270 + labour £1,170) adds up to £2,440.00, not £2,370.00. Please confirm the correct subtotal, VAT and total.
3. Please clarify how the 10% Northbridge commission is applied, and whether it is included in or on top of the total.
4. Please confirm what the 50% deposit is calculated on and the amount in pounds.
Please state clearly which figure is final so we can put a single quote to the landlord. Thank you.

args.subject: Which quote - 4 Thistlewick Rise, Larkcombe, ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body: Hi Orin, apologies for the confusion about the shower leak at 4 Thistlewick Rise, Larkcombe, ZZ1 1ZZ. There is only one quotation, from Hearthline Plumbing & Bath (ref NBL-001-Q1, 18 Sept): remove the shower screen, taps and valve; install wall-and-riser cladding with chrome trims; fit new bath taps and a new shower valve; refit the existing screen. It shows £2,370.00 + VAT £474.00 = £2,844.00. The second figure you may have seen is the contractor's later breakdown (materials £1,270, labour £1,170, plus a 50% deposit), which doesn't add up to the quote. I've asked the contractor for a corrected, itemised quote. Nothing is approved yet and no work will be booked. I will send you the confirmed figures to approve as soon as I have them. Please let me know if you were referring to a different quote.
